name: Life Cycles cuts Babify's cast time by 250ms and its mana cost by 15% (#2215)
contract: Life Cycles 680808 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (10) and EffectBasePoints -251, plus SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COST (14) and EffectBasePoints -16; both use EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x200000 and resolve to -250 and -15% with DieSides 1, matching the tooltip "Reduces the cast time of your Babify by 0.25 sec and its mana cost by $s2%." Babify 804461 has SpellFamilyFlags word0 2097152, CastingTimeIndex 16 (SpellCastTimes.dbc row 16 = 1500ms), ManaCost 25 with ManaCostPercentage 17, DmgClass 1 and AttributesEx3 0. Native path only: Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies the flat modifier inside SpellInfo::CalcCastTime before the haste multiplier, and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST after summing the percentage-of-base-mana component. Both fixtures share race, class and level, so their haste and base mana are identical.
